Bill.BriefDescription: Providing notification stickers to drivers with certain disabilities or impairments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing notification stickers to drivers withcertain disabilities or impairments; adding a new section to chapter46.16 RCW; creating a new section; prescribing penalties; and providingan effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds and declares that itis the policy of the state of Washington to encourage the safe use ofthe roads by all citizens. In furtherance of this policy and in orderto reduce problematic encounters and interactions between persons withdisabilities and medical and law enforcement personnel, the legislaturefurther finds and declares that the department of licensing shalldevelop a voluntary program whereby interested individuals may obtaina notification sticker for placement on their vehicle.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director shall grant a notification sticker to any personwho applies and has a disability or impairment that may affectinteractions with medical and law enforcement personnel. p. 1 HB 1152 (2) A person who applies for a notification sticker is entitled,upon payment of the applicable fee as determined by the department, toreceive from the department a yellow sticker bearing the internationalsymbol of access and the words "Not a Parking Permit." The departmentshall design the sticker to be displayed on the upper lefthand cornerof the driver's side front windshield of a vehicle or on the vehicle'srear license plate, as determined by the department. (3) An additional fee shall be charged for the issuance of thenotification sticker. The additional fee must be sufficient to coverthe costs associated with the notification sticker program and is inaddition to the regular motor vehicle registration fee and any otherfees and taxes required to be paid upon registration of a motorvehicle. (4) It is a traffic infraction with a monetary penalty of twohundred fifty dollars for any person to willfully obtain a notificationsticker issued under this section in a manner other than thatestablished under this section.
